items.t: TEVA Gets FDA Nod for Weltruza as Once-Monthly LAI in Schizophrenia
items.d: Teva wins FDA approval for Weltruza, the first once-monthly subcutaneous olanzapine injection for adults with schizophrenia, with a U.S. launch expected soon.

items.t: FDA approves Teva’s monthly injection of olanzapine for schizophrenia
items.d: Teva said it is debuting the drug to overcome adherence issues with an oral counterpart and improve symptom outcomes.

items.t: Teva, Already Up 26% This Year, Surges Again On First-Of-Its-Kind Approval
items.d: Teva stock surged Friday after the FDA approved its schizophrenia drug, a once-monthly injectable treatment for the disease.

items.t: TEVA Stock Hits Fresh 52-Week High As FDA Approves Monthly Schizophrenia Shot
items.d: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved Weltruza as an extended-release injectable suspension for adults with schizophrenia.
